grammar.composition_primitive: Two adjacent high-color campaign tiles with different image/copy compositions; equal visual area; global commerce header remains a shallow rail.
grammar.visual_hierarchy: Campaign words are embedded in art direction at large scale; each tile uses a compact supporting line and separate offer label.
grammar.typography_observation: Campaign words are embedded in art direction at large scale; each tile uses a compact supporting line and separate offer label.
grammar.media_observation: Food/product photography is tightly cropped within each tile; visual color fields distinguish the campaigns.
grammar.spatial_rhythm: Header then paired campaign panel, followed by a lower editorial/news module.
grammar.responsive_recomposition: Diptych becomes a vertical sequence; each campaign gets a full-width image/copy block; the header compresses to icons.
grammar.implementation_boundary: DOM: accessible campaign copy and links; independent images/crops per tile; CSS grid to stacked blocks; do not bake essential CTA text into images.
misuse_constraints: Both offers need equal-weight copy and independent destinations.
Do not make a tiled banner unreadable at 390px; serve mobile-specific crops.
Dates/prices in campaign copy require current source data.
